description.value:
The anticas have transformed the former Galkan capital of Altepa into the central location of their empire, a militaristic society built upon advanced personnel management.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Anticas gain +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, -2 Wisdom, and -2 Charisma.
  • Size: Anticas are Medium creatures.
  • Type: Anticas are Humanoid creatures with the antica subtype.
  • Base Speed: Anticas have a base speed of 30 feet and a 15-foot burrowing speed.
  • Languages: Anticas begin play understanding (but not speaking) Common and Antican. They can choose from Roegadyn, Galkan, Undercommon, Goblin, and Lamia.

Defense Racial Traits

  • This is Nothing: Anticas can handle extreme heat or desert conditions during day or night.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Natural Hunter: Anticas receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks.

Magical Racial Traits

  • Limited Telepathy: Anticas mentally communicate with any creature within 30 feet with whom they share a language.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Bite: Anticas gain a natural bite attack, dealing 1d4 points of damage.
  • Claws: Anticas receive two claw attacks dealing 1d4 damage.
  • Relentless: Anticas gain a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks made to bull rush or overrun an opponent while both are on the ground.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Minesight: Anticas have darkvision up to 60 feet but are automatically dazzled in bright light and take a –2 penalty on saving throws against light spells and effects.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Emotionless: Anticas take a –4 penalty on Sense Motive checks.
  • Unable to Cast: Anticas cannot cast spells normally without Silent Spell or Telepathic Spellcaster feat.
